source.method: OpenStreetMap as drawn (Overpass, the app's own query, Oct 4 2026): 18 hole ways, one course. A green, tee, bunker, fairway or hazard is kept within 150 m of a hole line; woods and water within 100 m. Multipolygons with holes (inner rings) are left out. Hole pars are OSM's, hole 5 (untagged) set to the card's 5.
source.caveat: Not traced by hand: as accurate as OSM. OSM and the course API disagree on holes 7 and 18 (OSM: 7 par 5 ~567 yds, 18 par 4; API card: 7 par 4 469 yds, 18 par 5 454 yds). The scorecard's par is what the app plays; the hole lines run tee to green either way.
